title: Replicating GPT-5 CoT Monitoring Advantage on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Direct chain: if CoT monitoring advantage replicates on open-source models, safety practitioners using open models can adopt it with confidence. Failure to replicate narrows the finding to frontier-only, which is also valuable information.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: MALT is publicly available with labeled transcripts. Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct runs on medium compute. The experiment is a straightforward A/B comparison (CoT+answer vs. answer-only). Well-documented tools and datasets. Beginner-friendly with mentor.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single model, single dataset, two conditions. Clear deliverable: AUROC comparison table. Focused replication with a well-defined protocol from the GPT-5 system card. Fits well within 30 hours.
